### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Fraser syndrome 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.730)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:25396)

**Proposed mechanism:** FREM2 (HGNC:25396) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix organization; Extracellular matrix organization —LEADS_TO→ Cryptophthalmos (HP:0000744); Extracellular matrix organization —LEADS_TO→ Lymphedema (HP:0000997). Loss-of-function mutations in FREM2 disrupt extracellular matrix organization, leading to both cryptophthalmos and lymphedema, which are key features of isolated cryptophthalmia and Fraser syndrome 2, respectively.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in FREM2 with a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect in patients with isolated cryptophthalmia or Fraser syndrome 2 would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Any pathogenic variant in FREM2 with a frequency > 0.1% in gnomAD exomes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of FREM2 in extracellular matrix organization provides a common therapeutic target for both isolated cryptophthalmia and Fraser syndrome 2, potentially through gene therapy or modulating ECM components.
